# Integrated ASIC Flow with LibreLane

## Concepts

Flow orchestration, configuration, reproducibility, and implementation checks.

## Implementation

Configure a LibreLane run and inspect how its stages transform RTL into layout artifacts.

## Hands-on Experiments

Run a small design through the flow and review timing, physical checks, and generated deliverables.

For each experiment, record the tool versions, design configuration, commands, inputs, expected results, and observed results.
